params.caption: 🎮 Shepard actor Jennifer Hale: EA should sell Mass Effect to the fans Jennifer Hale, the voice of female Commander Shepard, says EA should sell the Mass Effect IP directly to the community. She argues the gratitude fans would feel is something money can't buy: "you cannot buy that kind of goodwill." Her comments add to fan pressure over the series' future at EA. 🕒 Nov 19, 2026 · 01:50 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ 👥 @EA 👍 Agree with Hale?
